bugs.title: Can never win its roll
bugs.summary: Festive Holiday Rare: another reward always wins the roll before this plan gets its turn, so it never drops.
bugs.detail: In LLS_Festive_Rewards_Holiday_Rare, entry 1 (the list holding this plan (LLS_Festive_Rewards_Holiday_Rare_Taxidermy)) needs GetRandomPercent <= 20, but the list is First Match and the entries above it already claim every roll it needs — entry 0 (LLS_Festive_Rewards_Holiday_Rare_Chase, GetRandomPercent <= 40). It can never be picked.
